published.en: Participation policy. Every applicant is eligible. There is no minimum or maximum age and no residency requirement. If age is recorded, it is measured in completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp; it does not affect eligibility. The only condition for acceptance is that the system record the submission no later than 2027-10-18T16:00:00Z (UTC), including that exact instant. There are no other conditions or exceptions.

La única condición para la aceptación es que el sistema registre la presentación a más tardar el 2027-10-18T16:00:00Z (UTC), incluido ese instante exacto. No hay otras condiciones ni excepciones.

alice.text: Participation policy. Every applicant is eligible. There is explicitly no minimum or maximum age and no residency requirement.
